title: check/export: round-3 consistency fixes
description: Settled by Claude on implementer recommendation, for Mark's review (round 3, 2026-10-22): (1) an automation grant concurrent with a commit removing its accountable's authority is VOID with a warning, not an error (consistency with decision C and DESIGN 'like any approval'); (2) removal from anchors.json gives the ex-anchor's keys valid-before = committer date of the removing commit (consistency with D5); (3) a demotion/replacement tier record that does not verify does not end the earlier tier; (4) a replacement across the automation line ends the old tier at the new signed record's date; (5) a bot switching its accountable needs a new tier record; (6) a record signed by a since-revoked key is reported void before any date check (no spurious 'dated outside validity' error); (7) retire-key/export: a signature in the same second as retirement must not verify (valid-before is inclusive in ssh-keygen: export retired-1s or retire at now+1s, pick one and test); (8) merges: a person-file version may be signed by a key current in ANY parent (keep), and a merge restoring a version signed by a concurrently retired/revoked key gets the D1 warning; (9) an older already-merged person-file version that no longer parses strictly does not reset continuity (continuity depends on keys only).
acceptance_criteria: Each item has a test with real ssh-keygen signatures and real git history; DESIGN.md updated where it states the rule.
